verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own docs describe registrable outbound HTTP webhooks: you register a URL and AgentMail sends a POST request with event details as soon as an event happens. Webhook events can also be routed per tenant pod. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
